color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim as required. Light register: pageBackground #fcf7f1 (luminance 247.8).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist F: Line height loosening at intensity 3 — added 0.15 to all line-height values for a more open, airy reading rhythm. All fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans, Noto Sans, Lora) confirmed on Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Easing curve swap at intensity 3 — replaced 'ease' with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) (material standard) throughout all transition elements. Gives motion a physically grounded, deceleration-dominant character.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened 15% at intensity 3 — 1230px reduced to 1045px for a more editorial, constrained content column.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis at intensity 3 — hero margin values scaled ×1.5 (144px → 216px) giving the hero zone a generous, stage-like frame.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed — more languid at intensity 3. Added +0.15s to all hover transition durations (0.4s → 0.55s, 0.3s → 0.45s, 0.1s → 0.25s). Creates a measured, unhurried response to user input.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Item spacing spread at intensity 3 — nav link itemSpacing increased from 32px to 42px. Links breathe rather than cluster, matching the overall open editorial register.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — added a physical materiality detail to the Grid and Spacing section of Pattern 1, grounding the spatial logic in a tactile register (broadsheet proportions, gutter rules, binding edge). Generated new concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements.
